```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(shiny)
library(terra)
library(sf)
library(exactextractr)

options(width = 100)
terraOptions(progress = 0)

# learnr limits each exercise to 30 seconds by default.
# Raster calculations can require more time in Binder.
learnr::tutorial_options(
  exercise.eval = FALSE,
  exercise.timelimit = 300
)

# Resolve paths from the tutorial location instead of the RStudio working directory.
# Binder stores this project in /home/pawar, while RStudio may start in /home/rstudio.
# knitr::current_input() can return character(0) during the Shiny server phase.
# Build the candidate list without passing an empty path to normalizePath().
current_input_path <- tryCatch(
  knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE),
  error = function(e) character(0)
)

tutorial_candidates <- c(
  "/home/pawar",
  getwd()
)

if (length(current_input_path) == 1 && nzchar(current_input_path)) {
  tutorial_candidates <- c(
    tutorial_candidates,
    dirname(
      normalizePath(
        current_input_path,
        winslash = "/",
        mustWork = FALSE
      )
    )
  )
}

tutorial_candidates <- unique(tutorial_candidates)

tutorial_directory <- tutorial_candidates[
  file.exists(file.path(tutorial_candidates, "data", "rgb_orthomosaic.tif")) &
    file.exists(file.path(tutorial_candidates, "data", "plot_boundaries.geojson"))
][1]

if (is.na(tutorial_directory) || !nzchar(tutorial_directory)) {
  stop(
    "Could not locate the tutorial data folder. Expected data/rgb_orthomosaic.tif and data/plot_boundaries.geojson."
  )
}

orthomosaic_path <- file.path(
  tutorial_directory,
  "data",
  "rgb_orthomosaic.tif"
)

plots_path <- file.path(
  tutorial_directory,
  "data",
  "plot_boundaries.geojson"
)

if (!file.exists(orthomosaic_path)) {
  stop("Missing RGB orthomosaic: ", orthomosaic_path)
}

if (!file.exists(plots_path)) {
  stop("Missing plot boundaries: ", plots_path)
}

output_directory <- file.path(tutorial_directory, "outputs")
dir.create(output_directory, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

gli_path <- file.path(output_directory, "gli.tif")
threshold_path <- file.path(output_directory, "otsu_threshold.rds")
vegetation_mask_path <- file.path(output_directory, "vegetation_mask.tif")
vegetation_gli_path <- file.path(output_directory, "vegetation_gli.tif")
trait_table_path <- file.path(output_directory, "plot_level_rgb_gli_traits.csv")

rgb_raw <- terra::rast(orthomosaic_path)
plots_raw <- terra::vect(plots_path)

if (terra::nlyr(rgb_raw) < 3) stop("The RGB orthomosaic must contain at least three bands.")

rgb_raw <- rgb_raw[[1:3]]
names(rgb_raw) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

plot_id_candidates <- c("plot_id", "Plot_ID", "plot", "Plot", "id", "ID")
plot_id_matches <- plot_id_candidates[plot_id_candidates %in% names(plots_raw)]
if (length(plot_id_matches) == 0) {
  plots_raw$plot_id <- paste0("Plot_", seq_len(nrow(plots_raw)))
  plot_id_field <- "plot_id"
} else {
  plot_id_field <- plot_id_matches[[1]]
}

safe_gli <- function(red, green, blue) {
  denominator <- 2 * green + red + blue
  terra::ifel(denominator == 0, NA, (2 * green - red - blue) / denominator)
}

calculate_otsu_threshold <- function(raster, sample_size = 100000, bins = 256) {
  sampled <- terra::spatSample(
    raster,
    size = min(sample_size, terra::ncell(raster)),
    method = "regular",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    values = TRUE
  )
  values <- as.numeric(sampled[, 1])
  values <- values[is.finite(values)]
  if (length(values) < 2) stop("Not enough valid GLI values for Otsu thresholding.")

  h <- hist(values, breaks = bins, plot = FALSE)
  p <- h$counts / sum(h$counts)
  omega <- cumsum(p)
  mu <- cumsum(p * h$mids)
  mu_total <- sum(p * h$mids)
  variance <- (mu_total * omega - mu)^2 / (omega * (1 - omega))
  variance[!is.finite(variance)] <- NA_real_
  h$mids[which.max(variance)]
}

align_plots <- function(raster, polygons) {
  if (!terra::same.crs(raster, polygons)) {
    polygons <- terra::project(polygons, terra::crs(raster))
  }
  polygons
}
```

## Welcome

This tutorial uses simple exercise chunks that work in both `learnr` and the RStudio Console. All outputs use standard R plots and printed tables. There are no interactive raster maps, vector maps, Plotly charts, or interactive tables.

### Learning objectives

1. Inspect an RGB orthomosaic.
2. Name Red, Green, and Blue bands.
3. Calculate the Green Leaf Index (GLI).
4. Apply Otsu thresholding.
5. Create a vegetation mask.
6. Mask RGB and GLI layers.
7. Overlay plot polygons using a standard R plot.
8. Extract plot-level mean GLI, GLI variability, and canopy cover.
9. Export the plot-level trait table as a CSV file.

> The expected band order is Red, Green, Blue.

---

## Activity 1: Inspect the RGB orthomosaic

```{r inspect-raster, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw

print(rgb)
terra::nlyr(rgb)
terra::res(rgb)
terra::ext(rgb)
terra::crs(rgb)
```
---

## Activity 2: Display the RGB composite

```{r rgb-composite, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw

terra::plotRGB(
  rgb,
  r = 1,
  g = 2,
  b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "RGB True-Color Orthomosaic"
)
```
---

## Activity 3: Name and compare RGB bands

```{r compare-bands, exercise=TRUE}
rgb <- rgb_raw
names(rgb) <- c("Red", "Green", "Blue")

par(mfrow = c(1, 3))
plot(rgb[["Red"]], col = hcl.colors(100, "Reds"), main = "Red band")
plot(rgb[["Green"]], col = hcl.colors(100, "Greens"), main = "Green band")
plot(rgb[["Blue"]], col = hcl.colors(100, "Blues"), main = "Blue band")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

---

## Activity 4: Calculate and save GLI

```{r calculate-gli, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
rgb <- rgb_raw
red <- rgb[["Red"]]
green <- rgb[["Green"]]
blue <- rgb[["Blue"]]
denominator <- 2 * green + red + blue

gli <- terra::ifel(
  denominator == 0,
  NA,
  (2 * green - red - blue) / denominator
)
names(gli) <- "GLI"

terra::writeRaster(gli, gli_path, overwrite = TRUE)
plot(gli, col = hcl.colors(100, "RdYlGn"), main = "Green Leaf Index")
terra::global(gli, c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)
cat("GLI saved to:", gli_path, "\n")
```

### GLI histogram

```{r gli-histogram, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(gli_path)) stop("Run Activity 4 first. GLI file is missing.")
gli <- terra::rast(gli_path)
gli_values <- terra::values(gli, mat = FALSE)
gli_values <- gli_values[is.finite(gli_values)]
hist(gli_values, breaks = 80, col = "grey80", border = "white", main = "GLI Distribution", xlab = "GLI")
```

---

## Activity 5: Calculate and save the Otsu threshold

```{r otsu-threshold, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(gli_path)) stop("Run Activity 4 first. GLI file is missing.")
gli <- terra::rast(gli_path)
otsu_threshold <- calculate_otsu_threshold(gli)
saveRDS(otsu_threshold, threshold_path)
cat("Otsu GLI threshold:", round(otsu_threshold, 4), "\n")
values <- terra::values(gli, mat = FALSE)
values <- values[is.finite(values)]
hist(values, breaks = 80, main = "GLI and Otsu Threshold", xlab = "GLI")
abline(v = otsu_threshold, col = "red", lwd = 3, lty = 2)
cat("Threshold saved to:", threshold_path, "\n")
```

---

## Activity 6: Create and save the vegetation mask

```{r vegetation-mask, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(gli_path)) stop("Run Activity 4 first. GLI file is missing.")
if (!file.exists(threshold_path)) stop("Run Activity 5 first. Threshold file is missing.")
gli <- terra::rast(gli_path)
otsu_threshold <- readRDS(threshold_path)
vegetation_mask <- terra::ifel(gli > otsu_threshold, 1, 0)
names(vegetation_mask) <- "Vegetation_Mask"
terra::writeRaster(vegetation_mask, vegetation_mask_path, overwrite = TRUE, datatype = "INT1U")
plot(vegetation_mask, col = c("grey85", "forestgreen"), main = "Binary Vegetation Mask")
cat("Vegetation mask saved to:", vegetation_mask_path, "\n")
```

---

## Activity 7: Create and save vegetation-only GLI

```{r vegetation-gli, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(gli_path)) stop("Run Activity 4 first. GLI file is missing.")
if (!file.exists(vegetation_mask_path)) stop("Run Activity 6 first. Vegetation mask is missing.")
gli <- terra::rast(gli_path)
vegetation_mask <- terra::rast(vegetation_mask_path)
vegetation_gli <- terra::ifel(vegetation_mask == 1, gli, NA)
names(vegetation_gli) <- "Vegetation_GLI"
terra::writeRaster(vegetation_gli, vegetation_gli_path, overwrite = TRUE)
plot(vegetation_gli, col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"), main = "Vegetation-Only GLI")
cat("Vegetation-only GLI saved to:", vegetation_gli_path, "\n")
```

## Activity 8: Inspect and plot vector plots with IDs

Inspect the plot vector data, examine its attributes and coordinate reference system (CRS), and visualize the polygons with their `plot_id` labels.

### Step 1: Inspect the vector data

```{r inspect-vector, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!exists("plots_raw")) stop("Plot vector data are missing.")

# Inspect the vector object
print(plots_raw)

# Inspect attribute names and records
names(plots_raw)
head(as.data.frame(plots_raw))

# Check geometry type, feature count, and CRS
terra::geomtype(plots_raw)
nrow(plots_raw)
terra::crs(plots_raw)

# Check for plot_id
if (!"plot_id" %in% names(plots_raw)) {
  stop("The plot_id attribute is missing.")
}
```

### Step 2: Plot vector polygons with plot_id labels

```{r plot-vector-labels, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
# Plot the vector polygons
plot(
  plots_raw,
  col = "lightgreen",
  border = "darkgreen",
  main = "Study Plots with Plot IDs"
)

# Calculate label positions inside polygons
label_points <- terra::centroids(plots_raw, inside = TRUE)

# Extract label coordinates
coords <- terra::crds(label_points)

# Add plot_id labels
text(
  x = coords[, 1],
  y = coords[, 2],
  labels = plots_raw$plot_id,
  cex = 0.8,
  font = 2
)
```

### Questions

1. How many plots are present in the dataset?
2. What information is stored in the `plot_id`, `Range`, and `Row` attributes?
3. Why should we inspect vector data before overlaying it on a raster?

## Activity 9: Overlay plot boundaries

```{r plot-overlay, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(vegetation_gli_path)) stop("Run Activity 7 first. Vegetation GLI is missing.")
vegetation_gli <- terra::rast(vegetation_gli_path)
plots <- align_plots(vegetation_gli, plots_raw)
plot(vegetation_gli, col = hcl.colors(100, "YlGn"), main = "Vegetation GLI with Plot Boundaries")
plot(plots, add = TRUE, border = "black", lwd = 1.5)
```

---

## Activity 10: Extract and save plot-level traits

This activity reads the saved raster outputs. GLI is not recalculated.

```{r extract-traits, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=600}
if (!file.exists(vegetation_gli_path)) stop("Run Activity 7 first. Vegetation GLI is missing.")
if (!file.exists(vegetation_mask_path)) stop("Run Activity 6 first. Vegetation mask is missing.")
vegetation_gli <- terra::rast(vegetation_gli_path)
vegetation_mask <- terra::rast(vegetation_mask_path)
plots <- align_plots(vegetation_gli, plots_raw)

# exactextractr uses fractional pixel coverage at plot boundaries.
plots_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(plots)

vegetation_gli_stats <- exactextractr::exact_extract(
  vegetation_gli,
  plots_sf,
  fun = c("mean", "stdev"),
  progress = FALSE
)

canopy_cover_stats <- exactextractr::exact_extract(
  vegetation_mask,
  plots_sf,
  fun = "mean",
  progress = FALSE
)

plot_level_traits <- data.frame(
  plot_id = plots_sf[[plot_id_field]],
  mean_vegetation_gli = round(vegetation_gli_stats$mean, 4),
  sd_vegetation_gli = round(vegetation_gli_stats$stdev, 4),
  canopy_cover_percent = round(100 * canopy_cover_stats, 2)
)

write.csv(plot_level_traits, trait_table_path, row.names = FALSE, na = "")
print(plot_level_traits)
cat("Trait table saved to:", trait_table_path, "\n")
```

---

## Activity 11: Mean Vegetation GLI Heatmap

In this activity, visualize mean vegetation GLI for each study plot by overlaying transparent colors on the RGB orthomosaic.

```{r activity-10-gli-heatmap, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(trait_table_path)) {
  stop("Run the plot-level trait extraction activity first.")
}

plot_level_traits <- read.csv(trait_table_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Align polygons with the RGB raster
plots_aligned <- align_plots(rgb_raw, plots_raw)
plots_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(plots_aligned)

plots_sf$plot_id <- as.character(plots_sf[[plot_id_field]])
plot_level_traits$plot_id <- as.character(plot_level_traits$plot_id)

plots_heatmap <- merge(
  plots_sf,
  plot_level_traits[, c("plot_id", "mean_vegetation_gli")],
  by = "plot_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

gli <- plots_heatmap$mean_vegetation_gli

if (all(is.na(gli))) stop("No matching mean GLI values found.")

gli_range <- range(gli, na.rm = TRUE)
heat_cols <- hcl.colors(100, "YlGn")

bin <- rep(NA_integer_, length(gli))
valid <- !is.na(gli)

if (diff(gli_range) > 0) {
  bin[valid] <- cut(
    gli[valid],
    breaks = seq(gli_range[1], gli_range[2], length.out = 101),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = FALSE
  )
} else {
  bin[valid] <- 50
}

# Reserve space on the right for the legend
par(mar = c(4, 4, 4, 8), xpd = NA)

terra::plotRGB(
  rgb_raw,
  r = 1, g = 2, b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "Mean Vegetation GLI by Plot"
)

plot(
  sf::st_geometry(plots_heatmap),
  add = TRUE,
  col = grDevices::adjustcolor(heat_cols[bin], alpha.f = 0.60),
  border = "white",
  lwd = 1
)

# Label each plot with its mean GLI
label_points <- sf::st_point_on_surface(plots_heatmap)
coords <- sf::st_coordinates(label_points)

text(
  coords[, 1], coords[, 2],
  labels = ifelse(valid, sprintf("%.3f", gli), "NA"),
  cex = 0.8,
  font = 2,
  col = "black"
)

# Legend on the right
legend(
  "right",
  inset = c(-0.28, 0),
  legend = sprintf("%.3f", seq(gli_range[1], gli_range[2], length.out = 5)),
  fill = heat_cols[round(seq(1, 100, length.out = 5))],
  title = "Mean GLI",
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.8
)

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1), xpd = FALSE)
```


## Activity 12: Canopy Cover Heatmap

```{r activity-11-canopy-heatmap, exercise=TRUE, exercise.timelimit=300}
if (!file.exists(trait_table_path)) {
  stop("Run the plot-level trait extraction activity first.")
}

plot_level_traits <- read.csv(trait_table_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Align polygons with the RGB raster
plots_aligned <- align_plots(rgb_raw, plots_raw)
plots_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(plots_aligned)

plots_sf$plot_id <- as.character(plots_sf[[plot_id_field]])
plot_level_traits$plot_id <- as.character(plot_level_traits$plot_id)

plots_heatmap <- merge(
  plots_sf,
  plot_level_traits[, c("plot_id", "canopy_cover_percent")],
  by = "plot_id",
  all.x = TRUE,
  sort = FALSE
)

canopy <- plots_heatmap$canopy_cover_percent

if (all(is.na(canopy))) stop("No matching canopy cover values found.")

canopy_range <- range(canopy, na.rm = TRUE)
heat_cols <- hcl.colors(100, "Greens")

bin <- rep(NA_integer_, length(canopy))
valid <- !is.na(canopy)

if (diff(canopy_range) > 0) {
  bin[valid] <- cut(
    canopy[valid],
    breaks = seq(canopy_range[1], canopy_range[2], length.out = 101),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    labels = FALSE
  )
} else {
  bin[valid] <- 50
}

# Reserve space on the right for the legend
par(mar = c(4, 4, 4, 8), xpd = NA)

terra::plotRGB(
  rgb_raw,
  r = 1, g = 2, b = 3,
  stretch = "lin",
  main = "Canopy Cover by Plot"
)

plot(
  sf::st_geometry(plots_heatmap),
  add = TRUE,
  col = grDevices::adjustcolor(heat_cols[bin], alpha.f = 0.60),
  border = "white",
  lwd = 1
)

# Label each plot with canopy cover percentage
label_points <- sf::st_point_on_surface(plots_heatmap)
coords <- sf::st_coordinates(label_points)

text(
  coords[, 1], coords[, 2],
  labels = ifelse(valid, sprintf("%.1f%%", canopy), "NA"),
  cex = 0.8,
  font = 2,
  col = "black"
)

# Legend on the right
legend(
  "right",
  inset = c(-0.28, 0),
  legend = paste0(
    round(seq(canopy_range[1], canopy_range[2], length.out = 5), 1),
    "%"
  ),
  fill = heat_cols[round(seq(1, 100, length.out = 5))],
  title = "Canopy cover",
  bty = "n",
  cex = 0.8
)

par(mar = c(5.1, 4.1, 4.1, 2.1), xpd = FALSE)
```


## Workflow complete

Intermediate outputs are saved in the outputs folder and reused by later activities.
